title: Join SDPD's Retired Senior Patrol Volunteers!
description:
Getting it done! 👏 For the last year, San Diego Police have leveraged the department’s Retired Senior Patrol Volunteers (RSVPs) to help screen some reports of illegal encampments or illegally parked vehicles. These volunteers are checking reports made through the Get It Done system and helping triage them to the appropriate City department to address it. 

If the encampment is still active with people living there, the City will begin the process to address their needs and eventually clean up the encampment. If the encampment is abandoned, then the report is routed for the City to clean the area. Using RSVPs to help review some of the reports saves time, money and ultimately keeps officers available to respond to the community.

SDPD is looking for more volunteers! ⭐ Assisting with Get-It-Done reports is just part of the important work these volunteers do. More info: sandiego.gov/volunteer-program/opportunities/police#rsvp
